visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit modern kitchen, a young woman with long black hair, wearing a white graphic t-shirt and jeans, holds a wine bottle. A man in a green shirt stands behind her. She holds a long metal screw near the cork. (2) The scene transitions to a grayscale filter where the woman attempts to twist the long screw into the cork with her hands, exhibiting a strained but playful facial expression. (3) The man tries to pull the cork out manually using the screw but fails, with the woman laughing in the background. High-energy emojis and text overlays appear frequently. (4) The woman uses a black flat iron (hair straightener) to clamp and heat the glass neck of the wine bottle. She laughs and jokes around, even pretending to straighten her hair with the hot device. (5) As she continues to heat the bottle neck, she looks toward the camera with a mix of concentration and amusement. A digital notification bubble appears on screen. (6) Suddenly, the cork violently pops out of the bottle with a small puff of white smoke. The woman flinches back in shock and immediately collapses into laughter on the floor. (7) The incident is replayed in slow motion, highlighting her startled reaction and the cork's trajectory. (8) In the final phase, the woman sits on the floor holding the flat iron, still laughing hysterically, while a hand holds the popped cork in front of the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bouncy, lighthearted comedic background track. A woman's voice is heard laughing and speaking in a high-arousal, animated tone about opening a wine bottle. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs as they discuss using a screw. The man filming provides a humorous running commentary with clear articulation. (3) A sudden cartoonish 'ding' sound effect highlights a point of irony. The BGM maintains a steady, playful rhythm. (4) An digital notification chime (Uber Eats) interrupts the dialogue, marking a narrative beat. The woman's laughter becomes more intense. (5) A loud, explosive 'pop' sound effect triggers a new phase as the cork finally flies out, followed by a dense sequence of hysterical high-pitched laughter from both speakers. (6) In the slow-motion section, the master track is pitch-shifted downward, creating a distorted, comedic groaning vocal texture. The video concludes with a final cheerful 'ding' and comedic stinger.
